Priya — quick internal note.

We frequently hit two issues here: (1) GSuite/Exchange tenant rejects invites where the organizer is an external domain and auto-creates duplicate events in their calendar, and (2) external guests get an "access denied" when the provider tries to surface their Meet link. To avoid both, I recommend we:

1) Create a Redwood-hosted Zoom meeting and share the link in the body of the email (less reliance on ICS parsing).
2) Set the organizer on the ICS to a Redwood generic calendar (events@redwood.ai) or have Priya be the organizer — whichever GridWorks will allow.
3) Attach a plain-text updated-invite.ics as a fallback but also paste the Zoom link in the invite body.

I can create the Zoom host and share credentials if you want me to. Also: add a short note for GridWorks ops that the call will be hosted by a vendor Zoom room to avoid auto-removal.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
